crossRefs.note: “Your words have been stout against me,” says Yahweh. “Yet you say, ‘What have we spoken against you?’
I tell you that every idle word that men speak, they will give account of it in the day of judgment.
He called him, and said to him, ‘What is this that I hear about you? Give an accounting of your management, for you can…
So then each one of us will give account of himself to God.
About these also Enoch, the seventh from Adam, prophesied, saying, “Behold, the Lord came with ten thousands of his…
to execute judgment on all, and to convict all the ungodly of all their works of ungodliness which they have done in an…
For Yahweh knows the way of the righteous, but the way of the wicked shall perish.
For God will bring every work into judgment, with every hidden thing, whether it is good, or whether it is evil.
“Therefore I will judge you, house of Israel, everyone according to his ways,” says the Lord Yahweh. “Return, and turn…
“But when the Son of Man comes in his glory, and all the holy angels with him, then he will sit on the throne of his…

that all may honor the Son, even as they honor the Father. He who doesn’t honor the Son doesn’t honor the Father who…
Don’t marvel at this, for the hour comes in which all who are in the tombs will hear his voice,
and will come out; those who have done good, to the resurrection of life; and those who have done evil, to the…
He commanded us to preach to the people and to testify that this is he who is appointed by God as the Judge of the…
because he has appointed a day in which he will judge the world in righteousness by the man whom he has ordained; of…

Behold, I tell you a mystery. We will not all sleep, but we will all be changed,
in a moment, in the twinkling of an eye, at the last trumpet. For the trumpet will sound and the dead will be raised…
I command you therefore before God and the Lord Jesus Christ, who will judge the living and the dead at his appearing…
Don’t grumble, brothers, against one another, so that you won’t be judged. Behold, the judge stands at the door.

translations.web: They will give account to him who is ready to judge the living and the dead.
translations.bsb: But they will have to give an account to Him who is ready to judge the living and the dead.
translations.kjv: Who shall give account to him that is ready to judge the quick and the dead.
